name: wespa_word_wars
notes: WESPA Word Wars (Nigel Richards vs Adam Logan, Albany Marriott NY), YouTube broadcast "Nigel Richards vs Adam Logan - Wespa Word Wars Games 1-7". Corners validated against Game 1 move 2 (board showing QAT/HUIA aligned correctly). Noted as slightly off for a later, busier Game 2 frame (top-left corner cut off) -- not yet re-calibrated for that case; re-verify before trusting on a new frame from later in a game. | occupancy_diff_threshold tuned 2026-07-25 against a real empty-board frame: the NASPA-tuned diff default (25.0) caused real empty cells to spuriously score as occupied, because WESPA premium squares carry visible printed text ("DOUBLE LETTER SCORE" etc) the original threshold never had to reject. Raised to 38.0, safely below every observed real-tile diff score. | occupancy_gradient_threshold set to 500 (effectively disabled) 2026-07-25, root-caused via the center square (7,7)'s LPS sponsor-logo overlay, which produced 61/61 false PLAY detections in one real run_watcher.py run against a genuine game-start clip (t=5020-5060s of the broadcast). Root cause: occupancy_scores()'s gradient signal is computed from the CURRENT crop alone -- it never compares to any reference -- so a busy static graphic (colorful text on black) scores high gradient purely from its own texture, indistinguishable from a real tile's gradient (measured overlapping ranges: logo ~110-116 vs real occupied tiles 98-170). No reference-matching trick can fix a signal that never looks at the reference; only diff (which does compare to the reference) can. diff alone cleanly separates the logo (0.5-3.3 once correctly referenced) from a real tile (>=42), exactly what this module's own long-standing threshold comment already predicted ("diff alone would have worked"). Also replaced the primary reference_board_path with a properly verified frame from this exact clip -- the previous one had never been checked against the center cell specifically and was subtly wrong there. Verified fixed: the same real clip that produced 61/61 false detections now produces 0/0 through the full run_watcher.py pipeline (stillness gate included). Minor accepted trade-off: the separate mid-game clip's spurious-cell count went from 12 to 15 (missed stayed 0) since gradient was catching a few cells diff alone doesn't -- a small cost for fixing the far more consequential fresh-game-start false-positive rate. | reference_board_path is a SESSION-SCRATCHPAD path, not committed to the repo (real broadcast photo, same copyright policy as every other real photo here) -- recreate it (rectify a real, unoccluded, settled board frame with this profile's calibration(), checking EVERY cell including center, not just overall alignment) if this exact path no longer exists.
